items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday after limited practice all week on high-ankle sprain return.
items.why: Rapoport sources; Schefter/Pelissero corroborate expected activation and play; ETR had Q.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex upgrade for Drake Maye offense; Berry starting as WR2 if active.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as NE WR1; may be eased but must-start fantasy.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley. Confirmed by Schefter ruling.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; Schefter official ruling out vs Panthers.
items.implication: PHI RB room thinned to 4th-string Dameon Pierce; McKee at QB.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/snap share to remaining backs and pass-catchers (Goedert, Smith, Wicks).

items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT; Eagles not planning IR despite indefinite sidelining for superficial blood clot. First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter/Rapoport sources confirm no IR plans, clot monitoring.
items.implication: McKee QB with healthy top-4 pass-catchers (Smith, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon) but thin RB.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for PHI pass-catchers; McKee streaming appeal in some formats.

items.text: DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report, no designation for Sunday vs TB. Freiermuth (calf) added as Q.
items.why: Schefter report on Steelers IR update.
items.implication: Full Metcalf in thin PIT WR room per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Heavy target share expected in 2-WR sets.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered; relief on possible return.
items.why: Pelissero/Rapoport activation news; personal roster need.
items.implication: Must-start if active despite possible snap limit.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Warren Friday Q add (groin). Probable-like: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Olave, Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so Metcalf heavy 2-WR with Bernard. PHI McKee + top-4 healthy pass-catchers but 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.why: Practice context and report parsing; doubts high-ankle severity for Henderson given practice.
items.implication: Start Metcalf confidently; monitor Brown/Henderson closely; PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes in 2-WR; Warren TE upside if active; PHI WR/TE targets.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT again (ankle); Ravens play another game without him. Tyler Huntley starts.
items.why: ETR OUT; Rapoport notes another game without; coach confirmation.
items.implication: Huntley QB; Flowers remains startable WR2, Andrews downgraded.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers volume holds; backup QB stream if needed.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin); will not travel/play for Texans in London vs Jags.
items.implication: Texans RB committee shifts; Joe Mixon or backups elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU RBs.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) with Tyquan Thornton; KC without key WR.
items.implication: Xavier Worthy/others target bump with Mahomes.
items.opportunity: Worthy route/target share increase; Kelce volume.

items.text: IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr (vs Texans context).
items.why: ETR Friday/Sunday list of full participants or removed.
items.implication: Full roles expected; Smith boosts PHI with McKee; Lamb/Jeanty/McConkey startable.
items.opportunity: Restored snap/route shares; reverse prior beneficiary fades.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed high-ankle sprain, practiced but surprised; may be more about next Thursday availability than full Week 6. Levitan doubts legit high-ankle severity given practice.
items.why: Player comments + Graziano note on short week; Levitan practice skepticism.
items.implication: Rhamondre Stevenson lead back upside; monitor GTD.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR AD Mitchell again for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Full Braelon Allen workload as Jets lead back.
items.opportunity: Allen RB2 upside vs NE; Hall handcuff value.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI) for elite recent usage and soft run defense matchup; also Javonte Williams goal-line role @GB and Rhamondre Stevenson volume vs NYJ (Henderson limited).
items.why: Volume + leaking run Ds; Kyren usage elite, Javonte RZ, Rhamondre lead with Henderson ankle.
items.implication: Strong RB starts; Stevenson upgrade if Henderson limited/out.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans, Drake London, George Kittle (vs WSH soft) and Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH); hates Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: WSH buffet for pass-catchers; high-scoring environments for QBs; ugly matchups/QB issues for hates.
